description: Generate the printable receipt PDF for one transaction. Pass the transaction id from mhlb_list_transactions; the server fetches that transaction’s detail record and has the endpoint render it, so the receipt always reflects the account’s real data. Locally the PDF is written to disk and its path returned (or the bytes inline as base64 with inline: true); on a hosted server it comes back as a signed, expiring download link (url, expiresAt).

inline.description: Return the PDF as base64 in the result instead of writing it to a file. Default false. On a hosted server a report over the inline limit comes back as a download link instead.

isCreditType.description: Render as a credit rather than a payment. Default false.

name: mhlb_print_transaction
